sources.snippet: AI-Based Auto Parallelization Advisor This project uses a fine-tuned deberta-v3-small model to predict whether a given C/C++ code snippet (specifically a for loop) can be parallelized with an OpenMP pragma. The model was trained on the open-omp-plus dataset.
